subject: general
question:
The following table shows the number of students from different schools who appeared for an entrance exam to a well ranked university, and the number of students who got selected after appearing for the exam. Based on the table answer the question given below.

 
 

 School
 Appeared
 Selected
 
 

 K.V.
 1000
 800
 
 

 D.A.V.
 1200
 1050
 
 

 H.P.S.
 1500
 1350
 
 

 D.P.S.
 1100
 900
 
 

 J.M.I.
 900
 750
 
 

Which school from the following has the least number of students selected to the university, in comparison to the number of students who appeared for the exam
solution:
**Given:**

Number of students appeared and selected from different schools:

K.V.: Appeared = 1000, Selected = 800

D.A.V.: Appeared = 1200, Selected = 1050

H.P.S.: Appeared = 1500, Selected = 1350

D.P.S.: Appeared = 1100, Selected = 900

J.M.I.: Appeared = 900, Selected = 750

**Formula used:**

Selection Rate = (Number of students selected / Number of students appeared) × 100

**Calculations:**

K.V.: Selection Rate = (800 / 1000) × 100 = 80%

D.A.V.: Selection Rate = (1050 / 1200) × 100 = 87.5%

H.P.S.: Selection Rate = (1350 / 1500) × 100 = 90%

D.P.S.: Selection Rate = (900 / 1100) × 100 = 81.82%

J.M.I.: Selection Rate = (750 / 900) × 100 = 83.33%

The school with the least selection rate is K.V.

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
